premises.text: Open Garden is a mesh networking app that shares mobile internet among phone, tablet, and laptop by crowdsourcing connectivity
premises.evidence_span: OpenGarden is a mesh networking application that enables you to share your mobile internet among your phone, tablet, and laptop

premises.text: Installing the app also yields faster and more reliable mobile internet for the user
premises.evidence_span: you also benefit from a faster mobile internet and more reliable mobile internet

premises.text: The product is available on Android, Mac, and Windows, and network quality improves as more people join
premises.evidence_span: the more people on the OpenGallery network, the better connectivity we can all achieve together

value.text: Users get shared, faster, more reliable mobile internet through a public mesh network
value.evidence_span: share your mobile internet among your phone, tablet, and laptop

causal_links.evidence_span: the more people on the OpenGallery network, the better connectivity we can all achieve together

notes: Thin traction/fundraising thank-you pitch. Seed raise, press, install counts, and hiring CTA excluded (§4.2). User hurricane/Japan/India stories treated as anecdotal evidence of the mesh mechanism, not separate premises. Singleton D2 retained: multi-platform adoption/network-effect condition separately revisable from core mesh sharing.
